title: AWS credentials in Spring services
prompt: Why should a Spring service on ECS or EKS avoid static access keys?
answer: Use the default credentials provider chain with an attached role (task role or IRSA/Pod Identity) so credentials are short-lived, scoped, and rotated automatically.
explanation: Use the default credentials provider chain with an attached role (task role or IRSA/Pod Identity) so credentials are short-lived, scoped, and rotated automatically.
